raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
- `test_mix_with_running_mamba_track.py` read `track_index` off `_MambaRadixCacheV2TrackEntry`, which #45472 replaced with `track_position`; the test was added in #45435 and both landed on main, so `base-a-test-cpu` fails with `AttributeError`.
- Assemble `mamba_track_indices` the way `prepare_for_extend` now does: gather each request's ping-pong slot at its `track_position` with `_gather_mamba_track_indices`.

Test-only change; assertions are unchanged.
